experiment: E39 class-count-invariant ECDF calibration for the pure-EEG WCCN branch
motivation: E38 showed the DINO image branch adds nothing and the U gate fails at q=0.05. E36E showed the ECDF-mapped distance_ratio transfers from K=8 inner to K=16 outer with almost no loss. This experiment tests whether the same calibration transfers to the K=20 fully-enrolled regime that matches the official Test (20 registered identities), and whether a threshold chosen only on inner K=8 reaches U>=0.95 while keeping C>=0.99.

feature.description: five-band 1-40 Hz logSPD, detrend + zband, frozen from E36

calibration.rule: per-fold ECDF of the fit-fold known distance_ratio; u = count(reference <= r) / n
calibration.reason: the raw distance_ratio scale depends on the number of enrolled classes; the ECDF makes the threshold class-count invariant
calibration.reference_source: fit-fold known trials only; never evaluation or Test

protocol.k20_oof: all 20 subjects enrolled; per subject/task first 80% continuous block fit, last 20% continuous block OOF; no held-out unknown, so K=20 is a C-only transfer check
protocol.threshold_selection: inner K=8 pooled known-OOF ECDF only; 101 quantiles from 0 to 0.05; constraint inner known acceptance >= 0.95; maximize 100*C^0.40*U^0.25
protocol.proxy_warning: C/U-only selection proxy; the adversarial A term is not part of this experiment

required: K20 OOF direct C and macro-F1
reporting.test_metrics: N/A: no public Test labels; Test not read
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy; not cross-session evidence
